settings.instrumentation: External procfs application at nominal 20 Hz and target/scheduler/controller at nominal 1 Hz, independent CPU/memory/fd fields; optional identical exception catch/log/rethrow observer
settings.serialization: Unchanged B21 static JSON, typed Fluent and DTO path

cpu_meaning: Application includes managed host, Rust/SQLite and HTTP server. CPU percent is relative to one core. Original summaries are retained, with endpoint arithmetic checked independently. Sampled resource phases and whole request observation durations differ.
latency_meaning: Successful operation completion minus scheduled arrival, from original reader. Conditional cycle/page values belong to the same mixed load, with no independent CPU allocation. Original p50 and statistics.median are both retained and can differ for even sample counts.
limits: The old 567.131236 ms selected2f SQLite C16 p99 failure and EA5 232.540914 ms comparison remain preserved.
Current2f already includes earlier product changes; candidatea5748 is isolated and is not an accepted final product.
The loaded DB and Server managed hosts both use the candidate 1 ms retry interval; this application experiment cannot separate their contribution.
The candidate source tree also contains the prior gRPC buffer change; this HTTP/1.1 SQLite application does not exercise gRPC.
Fixed offered rate does not measure sustainable throughput capacity.
No repeated significance/noise algorithm was run; the unchanged original A21 percentile reader is the source of all displayed latency metrics.
Idle is after measured load and recovery, while the server still listens; it precedes final shutdown.
This publication independently checks completed metadata and hash bindings, not a new raw request/resource-series replay.
Package manifest previous member contains the actual tested .1 packages; candidate member is a separate .2 update witness.

paired_descriptive_changes.interpretation: Descriptive same-repetition arithmetic only; no new or reused between-cohort noise verdict.
Descriptive same-repetition arithmetic only; no new or reused between-cohort noise verdict.

provider_error_scope: Catch/log/rethrow counts cover the complete application lifetime, including seed/warmup/recovery; not a measurement-only BUSY count
retry_scope: Explicit benchmark business retries across the run; same-key replay is a declared operation. Internal SQLite busy-handler attempts are unobserved.
scope: Three independent current2f/candidatea5748 process pairs in AB/BA/AB order; original 50 op/s, C16, 60-second SQLite business/page application workload. No EA5 baseline, Rust comparator, capacity or 30-minute acceptance claim.
